description: One row per step a campaign took for a patient, and what happened at it.

fields.label: Journey
fields.description: The journey this step belongs to.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: The patient the journey is about.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: What happened at this step: a verb's own declared output (sent, assigned, queued, nobody, failed), `suppressed` when a send was made while the sends switch is off, or a control word the interpreter writes (ok, parked, resumed, done).

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: The way the patient was reached - WhatsApp, voice or email. Blank where the step contacts nobody.

fields.label: Contact
fields.description: The number or address actually used. NO search_index: the one reader is the contact cap, which counts a ROLLING window, and ix_contact_creation (contact, creation) serves that and every contact-only read the flag's single-column index could — leaving the flag on would rebuild a duplicate here on every migrate.

fields.label: Detail
fields.description: Readable detail of what happened, such as the branch taken or the failure message.

fields.label: Duration (ms)
fields.description: The time the step took, in milliseconds.

name: CRM Workflow Step Log
